blocks.en: In the previous section we showed that if the data and coefficients are sufficiently smooth, then weak solutions of elliptic problems are ``as smooth as one could expect\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ in the interior of the domain on which the problem is posed. In the following example we see that a solution is not necessarily smooth up to the boundary of the domain on which the problem is posed if that boundary is not sufficiently smooth. (The reader should also note that this is not some sort of weird ``cooked up\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ counterexample; the domain in question simply has a corner.)
blocks.zh: 前一节说明, 若数据和系数足够光滑, 则椭圆问题的弱解在问题所在区域的内部具有 ``可以预期的光滑性\textquotesingle\textquotesingle. 以下例子表明, 若边界不够光滑, 则解未必光滑到问题所在区域的边界. (读者还应注意, 这不是某种奇怪的 ``人为构造\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ 的反例; 所考察的区域只是有一个角点.)
